own_solution.law: Doppler effect for reflection from a moving wall: wall receives f(c+v)/c and re-emits as a moving source, echo f' = f(c+v)/(c-v); beat = f' - f = 2fv/(c-v) = 2*440*3/340
assumptions: wall moves at 3 m/s relative to a stationary trolley

notes: Trolley moving towards the loudspeaker at 1.4 m/s makes the wall's ground speed 4.4 m/s: beat = 2*440*4.4/(343-4.4) = 3872/338.6 = 11.4353 Hz. Conveyor stirs no air, so D. Wall distance 90 m sets the echo delay but not the echo frequency in steady state, so it drops out (C; one might also call it D for the frequency). T72F4 and TAC5B both state 90 m; the 1.4 m/s sentences agree; T544D and T1B41 carry no number ('a low speed').
